''See also: [[Lycus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Lycus [[Agnos]] is a young boy of [[Damascan]] descent, characterized by blond hair and tanned skin. The son of a free merchant for [[Malachi]], he is the younger brother of [[Andra Agnos]]. Throughout his development, Lycus transitions from a ten-year-old child who viewed [[Simon]] as a hero to an eleven-year-old living in [[Valinhall]], where he has endured physical hardships including a broken nose. He is often depicted as serious and intense, frequently displaying a determined or scowling demeanor compared to his sister's more playful nature. In combat and training, Lycus utilizes a short [[sword]] or long knife, which is notably smaller and less sophisticated than the weapons used by his sister or other combatants. Despite his youth and lack of innate magical or physical advantages like those possessed by certain [[Travelers]], he demonstrates bravery and a protective instinct toward his family. He has attempted to defend his father against mechanical threats and has engaged in combat training against opponents like [[Chaka]]. His experiences include navigating dangerous environments, seeking help during crises, and dealing with the complex social and political realities of [[Valinhall]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Lycus carries a [[sword]] that is disproportionately large for his size. He has been observed appearing out of breath and visibly emotional.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|He is the brother of [[Andra Agnos|Andra]] and the son of [[Caius Agnos|Caius]]. Lycus shows a brightened disposition when seeing [[Simon]], though he reacts to his sibling's laughter with weary head-shaking.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Lycus is the brother of [[Andra Agnos|Andra]] and the son of [[Caius Agnos|Caius]]. He was rescued by [[Simon]], whom he reacted to with brightness. Additionally, Lycus witnessed [[Erastes]] engaged in a fight with [[Benson]].}}
